args.title: July 2023 analysis ownership card
args.body:
# July 2023 analysis ownership card

Scope: July 2023 only. These were temporary July work assignments, not a current standing org rule or permanent org chart.

- Helio Start baseline analysis — Default owner: Owen. Owned the first-pass baseline readout shape, including the measurement cut, sample, caveats, and unusable evidence.
- Retained-mid expansion eligibility analysis — Default owner: Owen. Owned the first-pass eligibility and measurement cuts for Expansion Assist exploration, including sample, caveats, and unusable evidence.

The lanes were distinct: guarded Helio Start pre-discovery analysis remained separate from retained-mid expansion eligibility analysis. Riley retained decision rules and executive tradeoffs; this card records the July allocation only.
